options.label: ASA I: A normal healthy patient
ASA II: A patient with mild systemic disease
ASA III: A patient with severe systemic disease
ASA IV: Severe systemic disease that is a constant threat to life
ASA V: Moribund, not expected to survive without the operation
ASA VI: Declared brain-dead, organs being removed for donation

interpretation.label: Perioperative risk classification
interpretation.action: Higher class indicates greater perioperative risk. Add 'E' suffix for emergency procedures (not modelled here).
